mines.mine_notes: Underground silver mine, Anti-Atlas region (100% owned; expanded plant commissioned 2024). FY2025: mined 1,036,570 t (2,840 tpd); milled 1,178,420 t @ 145 g/t Ag (down 15% from 171 g/t in 2024); combined mill recovery 88.4% (up from 83.7%); plant availability 96%. Silver production 4,829,151 oz (+193% vs 2024). Cash cost $20.41/AgEq oz sold (Zgounder; $20.25 consolidated). P&P reserves 73.39 Moz Ag @ 145 g/t (15,700 kt). 2026-2036 outlook: ~6 Moz Ag/year average; LOM cash cost $16.26/oz, $69.47/t processed.

mines.mine_notes: Polymetallic gold-silver-zinc-lead project, eastern Anti-Atlas; Aya 85% / ONHYM 15% (3% royalty to ONHYM). Development stage (PEA: LOM cash cost $928/AuEq oz, AISC $1,021/AuEq oz, $109/t milled). In 2025, 13,498 t reclaimed/crushed from historical pyrite stockpiles @ 2.87 g/t Au and 192 g/t Ag, producing 172,129 AgEq oz (Ag/Au ratio 71). Exploration: 150,325 m drilled in 2025. No reserves disclosed.

notes: FY2025 MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025). Costs are per silver-equivalent oz (non-IFRS); no per-oz Ag AISC disclosed. Reserves are Zgounder P&P only. All amounts in USD unless noted.
